scientific_integrity: All Fourier modes are controlled asymptotically for each fixed c on either side of pi. The boundary case and globally unique finite-size thresholds are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Results are asymptotic in cyclic order N and assume equally spaced points.
Nyquist root asymptotics are proved only along multiples of four and do not assert global uniqueness.
One relevant 1995 article was not materially available in full.
title: The sharp \(\pi/N\) Gaussian covariance transition on discrete circles
